remarks: Walk to Vibrant Downtown Stamford from this beautifully updated two bedroom apartment. Open layout with newer updated Kitchen with granite countertops and SS appliances, sun-filled living room, and dining area all with beautiful hardwood floors. Two nice size bedrooms and updated bath. W/D in unit and extra storage in the basement. Close to transportation, schools, shopping etc. Don't miss the opportunity to live in this very special complex with a short walk to everything.  Purchasers must meet co-op financial and lending requirements. Board approval required.
